svg.text: 2026-06-12 · 16 Postgres schemas · 82 tables · 61 tables carry a designed tenant-isolation policy · source: packages/database/src/schema/*.ts — verified against the live catalog (pg_class / pg_policies)

⚠ RLS GAP (OXA-1700): the Atlas baseline 20260611233016 applies NO row-level-security DDL — shield icons mark the DESIGNED tenant_isolation policy (tenant-policy.manifest.ts); none are active in any environment until OXA-1700 lands.
Scope & RLS icons (top-right of each table)
faded icon + “null” = scoping column nullable · combinations compose: e.g. shield+org+ws+user = user-owned rows inside an org+workspace tenant
Field-mixin chips (columns not repeated per table)
id_mixin: id uuid PK (UUIDv7) · public_id citext UQ NN (prefixed)
audit_mixin: created_at ts NN · updated_at ts NN · created_by_user_id uuid · updated_by_user_id uuid
soft_delete_mixin: deleted_at ts · deleted_by_user_id uuid (hard deletes prohibited)
org_scope_mixin: org_id uuid NN → org.organizations · workspace_id uuid NN → workspace.workspaces
version_mixin: version_number int NN · is_latest bool NN · parent_version_id uuid · published_at ts
timestamps only: created_at ts NN · updated_at ts NN
flags: PK · UQ unique · NN not null · df: default · ✓ CHECK constraint · ⇊ ON DELETE CASCADE · PK* composite · →schema.table = foreign key (colored by target schema)

Generated 2026-06-12 for Oxagen v0.4.1 (pre-release stamp: 0.4.0 + 1 patch). Cross-schema relationships are shown as colored →schema.table annotations on the FK column; intra-schema FKs are also drawn as edges. Postgres is the transactional store only — graph data lives in Neo4j, runtime events in ClickHouse, binary assets in blob storage (see Infrastructure Boundaries, CLAUDE.md).
